help_text: ℹ️ How does this bot work? 1. The bot monitors cheapestinference.com/pools 24/7 through isolated, anonymous Tor proxy streams. 2. Each compute tier is divided into three daily 8-hour regional blocks (Asia, Europe, Americas). 3. You can inspect live availability anytime from the interactive dashboard. 4. Tap any pool card on the main dashboard to configure custom event filters. 5. The moment compute becomes available, you receive an instant alert with a 1-click checkout button! 🆔 Your Telegram ID: {telegram_id} 👨‍💻 Author Contact / Support: Telegram: @grizlizora
